sqlite:
CREATE TABLE documents (
	title VARCHAR(240) NOT NULL, 
	description TEXT NOT NULL, 
	department_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	specialty VARCHAR(120) NOT NULL, 
	kind VARCHAR(80) NOT NULL, 
	language VARCHAR(10) NOT NULL, 
	scope VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL, 
	creator_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	created_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	CHECK (scope IN ('ALL','DEPARTMENT','RESTRICTED')), 
	FOREIGN KEY(department_id) REFERENCES departments (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(creator_id) REFERENCES users (id)
)

CREATE INDEX ix_documents_department_id ON documents (department_id)

CREATE TABLE document_permissions (
	document_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	user_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (document_id, user_id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(document_id) REFERENCES documents (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(user_id) REFERENCES users (id)
)


CREATE TABLE document_versions (
	document_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	number INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	status VARCHAR(30) NOT NULL, 
	processing VARCHAR(30) NOT NULL, 
	file_key VARCHAR(150) NOT NULL, 
	filename VARCHAR(240) NOT NULL, 
	sha256 VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	uploader_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	effective_date VARCHAR(10), 
	review_date VARCHAR(10), 
	error VARCHAR(300) NOT NULL, 
	id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	created_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	UNIQUE (document_id, number), 
	CHECK (status IN ('DRAFT','PENDING_REVIEW','APPROVED','ARCHIVED','REJECTED')), 
	FOREIGN KEY(document_id) REFERENCES documents (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(uploader_id) REFERENCES users (id)
)

CREATE INDEX ix_document_versions_document_id ON document_versions (document_id)
CREATE INDEX ix_document_versions_status ON document_versions (status)

CREATE TABLE document_chunks (
	document_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	version_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	page INTEGER, 
	section VARCHAR(240) NOT NULL, 
	text TEXT NOT NULL, 
	embedding JSON NOT NULL, 
	embedding_model VARCHAR(150) NOT NULL, 
	id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	created_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(document_id) REFERENCES documents (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(version_id) REFERENCES document_versions (id)
)

CREATE INDEX ix_document_chunks_document_id ON document_chunks (document_id)
CREATE INDEX ix_document_chunks_version_id ON document_chunks (version_id)

CREATE TABLE source_citations (
	chunk_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	user_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	purpose VARCHAR(40) NOT NULL, 
	id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	created_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(chunk_id) REFERENCES document_chunks (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(user_id) REFERENCES users (id)
)


CREATE TABLE document_reviews (
	version_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	reviewer_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	decision VARCHAR(30) NOT NULL, 
	comment TEXT NOT NULL, 
	id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	created_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(version_id) REFERENCES document_versions (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(reviewer_id) REFERENCES users (id)
)


CREATE TABLE chat_conversations (
	user_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	title VARCHAR(150) NOT NULL, 
	id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	created_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(user_id) REFERENCES users (id)
)

CREATE INDEX ix_chat_conversations_user_id ON chat_conversations (user_id)

CREATE TABLE chat_messages (
	conversation_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	role VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL, 
	content TEXT NOT NULL, 
	citation_ids JSON NOT NULL, 
	helpful BOOLEAN, 
	id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	created_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(conversation_id) REFERENCES chat_conversations (id)
)

CREATE INDEX ix_chat_messages_conversation_id ON chat_messages (conversation_id)

CREATE TABLE background_jobs (
	user_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	kind VARCHAR(40) NOT NULL, 
	target_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	status VARCHAR(30) NOT NULL, 
	error VARCHAR(300) NOT NULL, 
	attempts INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	updated_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	result JSON NOT NULL, 
	id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	created_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(user_id) REFERENCES users (id)
)

CREATE INDEX ix_background_jobs_status ON background_jobs (status)
